name: foothold
description: Installable Obsidian vault pack for defence-sector founders. One command lays down a working second-brain: folder structure, page templates, skills, and pre-populated open-source defence reference content. Includes /foothold-setup (install and conversational onboarding), /foothold-update (pull new content into an existing pack without re-running setup), /add-contact (capture a person into the CRM), /add-organisation (capture a company or MOD body), and /add-event (log an event, with Chatham House check at intake).
